Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Folks:

I am trying to find the definitive statement about when more than 1
copy of a card can be played.

For example, I understand that a minion can use only 1 Lost in Crowds
(for stealth) or only 1 Eagle's Sight (for intercept) during any
action.

But what is prohibited? Just Reaction and Action Modifier cards?? I
cannot find any reference to this prohibition in the Revised Rulebook.
Could someone help me out and point me to the definitive statement?

Thanks,
Madman

Madman2001 wrote:
>
> Folks:
>
> I am trying to find the definitive statement about when more than 1
> copy of a card can be played.
>
> For example, I understand that a minion can use only 1 Lost in Crowds
> (for stealth) or only 1 Eagle's Sight (for intercept) during any
> action.
>
> But what is prohibited? Just Reaction and Action Modifier cards?? I
> cannot find any reference to this prohibition in the Revised Rulebook.
> Could someone help me out and point me to the definitive statement?

1.6.3.2: "A minion cannot play the same action modifier more than once
during a single action."

1.6.3.5: "A minion cannot play the same reaction card more than once
during a single action."

These are the only by-name restrictions.

Other restrictions include not canceling your own maneuvers or presses,
and not being able to play more than one addition-strike-gaining effect
per round. [6.4.2], [6.4.3], and [6.4.4]
